name: Artifact deploy
description: Saving a note that names an ep0ch-artifacts repo deploys it. Write [artifact::ep0ch-artifacts/<repo>] on its header or a line of its own; the repo decides where (Vercel, or float-2's static store). Installed per outline.

scripts.name: deploy-artifact
scripts.about: Deploys every ep0ch-artifacts repo the note it runs on names: what the kit's rule runs when such a note is saved

rules.description: Deploys the repos a note names when it starts naming one, and again each time it's saved
